svg.data-weight-note: 22.2 lb (10.6 kg) with two 650 W power supplies and four fan modules; 22.2 lb is 10.07 kg
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: guide Chapter 1 lists thirty-two 100G QSFP28 ports, supporting 10GE, 25GE, 40GE, 50GE and 100GE
svg.data-redundancy: two 1+1 power supplies and four 3+1 fan modules, all hot-swappable; the system works with a single fan failure and more than one fan failure shuts it down
